Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.vehicle.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Parser<Vehicle>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bicycle, Car, Scooter
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object implements Parser<Vehicle>, Serializable
Abstract parent class that vehicles with all attributes and methods in common. Implements interfaces Parser and Serializable.
